name: @bhoomabrsr/skimlet
description: Skimlet is a local MCP server for agents doing deep research. It reads search engine results pages (SERPs) and extracts page content in batches using your Chrome profile.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck mcp/mcp.ts relay-server/server.ts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bhoomabrsr/skimlet-extension && tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir dist mcp/mcp.ts relay-server/server.ts && chmod +x dist/mcp/mcp.js
